article.content: Can the dialectical logic with which Marx imagined a global proletarian revolution so many years ago be leveraged towards an ecological revolution today? The post Nicholas Denning Reviews The Dialectics of Ecology; John Bellamy Foster Responds appeared first on MR Online .
